currentParagraphText: “Oh, of course, let’s get going,” Jake said apologetically before he motioned for everyone to follow him as they headed down to this lab. Once there, they went to the room with the teleportation circle already prepared, and using his connection with the Malefic Viper as his Chosen, Jake began the minor ritual to initiate the teleportation.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Do hang on, everyone. The process is still a bit crude, and getting pulled through the void doesn’t tend to be the most pleasant of experiences. Especially for any first-timers,” Jake warned them all as he felt the bridge between universes form.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Her tone instantly made Jake feel bad about not having waited to have this conversation with Sylphie and the Sword Saint, as he failed to consider that he was making everyone else wait for him to talk. He also recalled how Vesperia had gone through quite an ordeal to return to the Endless Empire the first time she returned, making him feel even worse as she probably wanted to rush back as quickly as possible for safety.
